profile.reasoning: Marcus Martins is a 34-year-old founder and CEO of 'Synapse Insights,' a pre-seed AI-powered market research platform. He previously spent 5 years at a large, traditional market research firm (Nielsen) where he became deeply frustrated with the slow pace of innovation and reliance on outdated methodologies. This experience fuels his passion for building a faster, more accurate, and democratized market intelligence solution leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs). He's currently focused on closing a seed round, demonstrating strong early traction with beta users, and refining the core AI algorithms. He’s a very technical founder, deeply involved in the model training and data pipeline aspects, and often speaks in technical detail. He's a bit impatient with 'fluff' and prioritizes direct, efficient communication. He’s based in Austin, Texas, but open to remote work and travel. A key distinctive detail is he self-taught much of his machine learning expertise *after* leaving Nielsen, attending intensive online courses and building personal projects.
profile.positioning: As CEO and Founder of Synapse Insights, I'm building the next generation of market intelligence. We’re tackling the pervasive problem of slow, expensive, and often inaccurate market research by leveraging the power of Large Language Models. Traditional methods rely on manual surveys and analysis, resulting in delayed insights and significant costs. Synapse Insights automates this process, delivering real-time, data-driven insights at a fraction of the cost. We’re currently in pre-seed, demonstrating significant traction with a rapidly growing beta user base. Our proprietary AI algorithms analyze vast datasets – social media trends, news articles, product reviews, and more – to identify emerging market opportunities and predict consumer behavior. We’ve achieved a 30% MoM growth in beta user engagement and are seeing promising early conversion rates. I'm deeply passionate about applying cutting-edge AI to solve real-world business challenges and democratizing access to critical market information. We're not just building a product; we're building a platform that empowers companies of all sizes to make smarter, faster decisions. We are actively seeking strategic investors who share our vision and can contribute to our technical roadmap.
